tei:div.tei:p: To the God who rested from all His works on the seventh day, He rose and was seated on the throne of His glory, He draped Himself in splendour for the day of rest, a delight did He call the Sabbath day. This is the praise of the seventh day that on it God rested from all His work. And the seventh day praises and says: a psalm of the Sabbath day, it is good to thank the Lord. Therefore do all His creatures glorify and bless God, praise, honour and grandeur do they offer to God, the King, the Creator of all, who has bestowed rest as an inheritance upon His people Israel in His holiness on the Holy Sabbath day. Thy Name.Name, O Lord our God, be sanctified and Thy memory, O our King, be glorified in heaven above and on the earth below. Blessed art Thou, our Helper, for the glory of Thy handiwork and for the radiant lights that Thou hast made, they shall praise Thee, Selah.
